instruction: A candid action photograph shows a self-defense demonstration inside a karate dojo with yellow walls and red-and-blue floor mats. On the left, the woman in a black karate uniform with a red belt (R2) extends her right arm in a high punch. On the right, the older man in a black karate uniform with white stripes (R1) stands facing her, using his left hand to intercept and deflect her punch at head height. Both wear black protective goggles. The bright indoor overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the matted floor, highlighting their focused interaction.
